description: When I ran into her at a neighborhood event, I wanted to say a quick hello and thank her for her work, but she insisted that we sit down together and asked me “What issues do you care about? What matters to you?” She listened as I shared my thoughts on relevant issues and my hopes for our community, and she shared the legislation she has introduced and supported to move us all forward. That personal and authentic interaction seems rare these days in politics, but Robyn is continually here for the people.
